# Atlas - local code intelligence

> Atlas is a local code-intelligence CLI: one native binary that indexes a
> repository into a SQLite symbol and relationship graph and answers focused context queries
> (definition, callers, callees, imports, routes) in single-digit milliseconds and tens of tokens.
> Benchmark &amp; field comparison — refreshed at fc3b875 (2026-08-05, shipped in v0.1.51): 3.17× fewer answer tokens than the graph tool pooled over a
> 7-repository matrix, at a higher answer quality — caller-F1 0.865 vs 0.541.
> Inside a real agent harness on sirupsen/logrus with gopls ground truth (2026-10-29): F1 0.996.
> Same harness, 8 languages: Atlas beats both comparators on accuracy and tokens in 16/16 agent × language cells.
> 16 of 40 code languages are reference-validated (L5) on a five-level
> maturity ladder; dart was RETRACTED from L5 this refresh. Version 0.1.55.
> Earlier 20× and 36× token claims are RETRACTED: they were measured against a build whose
> caller answers were a two-token placeholder.

## Benchmark data
- [site-data.json](https://atlas.aziro.com/data/site-data.json): the full payload the page renders — headline table, efficiency frontier, detail knob, maturity ladder, scorecard, per-language results
- [CALLERS_F1_AFTER.json](https://atlas.aziro.com/data/raw/CALLERS_F1_AFTER.json): 37/37 native callers F1 (Linux corroboration run)
- [DIMENSIONS_BENCH_PUBLIC.json](https://atlas.aziro.com/data/raw/DIMENSIONS_BENCH_PUBLIC.json): per-language F1 / tokens / latency / index speed
- [LSP_F1_SUMMARY.json](https://atlas.aziro.com/data/raw/LSP_F1_SUMMARY.json): gopls LSP-truth aggregate
- [AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_PUBLIC_20261029.json](https://atlas.aziro.com/data/raw/AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_PUBLIC_20261029.json): end-to-end token usage of real agent harnesses (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex) with Atlas vs graph tool vs no tool, 2026-10-29 — reproducible via agent-bench/ in the GitHub repo
- [AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_GO_20261028.json](https://atlas.aziro.com/data/raw/AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_GO_20261028.json): the same harness on Go (sirupsen/logrus), 2026-10-28
- [AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_PYTHON_20261028.json](https://atlas.aziro.com/data/raw/AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_PYTHON_20261028.json): the same harness on Python (psf/requests), 2026-10-28
- [AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_C_20261028.json](https://atlas.aziro.com/data/raw/AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_C_20261028.json): the same harness on C (DaveGamble/cJSON), 2026-10-28
- [AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_JAVA_20261028.json](https://atlas.aziro.com/data/raw/AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_JAVA_20261028.json): the same harness on Java (google/gson), 2026-10-28
- [AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_CPP_20261028.json](https://atlas.aziro.com/data/raw/AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_CPP_20261028.json): the same harness on C++ (google/leveldb), 2026-10-28
- [AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_JAVASCRIPT_20261028.json](https://atlas.aziro.com/data/raw/AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_JAVASCRIPT_20261028.json): the same harness on JavaScript (axios/axios), 2026-10-28
- [AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_TYPESCRIPT_20261028.json](https://atlas.aziro.com/data/raw/AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_TYPESCRIPT_20261028.json): the same harness on TypeScript (vuejs/core), 2026-10-28
- [AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_RUST_20261028.json](https://atlas.aziro.com/data/raw/AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_RUST_20261028.json): the same harness on Rust (BurntSushi/ripgrep), 2026-10-28
- [TOOL_CALLERS_F1_LSP_20261029.json](https://atlas.aziro.com/data/raw/TOOL_CALLERS_F1_LSP_20261029.json): tool-level callers F1 against each language's LSP server, 8 languages, 2026-10-29
- [RELEVANCE_BENCH_20261029.json](https://atlas.aziro.com/data/raw/RELEVANCE_BENCH_20261029.json): natural-language relevance benchmark (216 labelled queries, 3 surfaces, regression gate), 2026-10-29 — harness in relevance-bench/
- [AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_PUBLIC_20261028.json](https://atlas.aziro.com/data/raw/AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_PUBLIC_20261028.json): the superseded 2026-10-28 agent-harness run (Atlas 0.1.54), kept in the run history for audit
- [AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_PUBLIC.json](https://atlas.aziro.com/data/raw/AGENT_TOKEN_BENCH_PUBLIC.json): the superseded 2026-08-05 agent-harness run (Atlas v0.1.47-256-gfc68e26-dirty), kept in the run history for audit

## Project
- [Product documentation](https://atlas.aziro.com/#docs/getting-started): install, index, query, configure, connect, troubleshoot, and upgrade
- [Ask Workbench](https://atlas.aziro.com/#docs/workbench): a conversation about the codebase in the dashboard — Atlas gathers cited evidence (index, git, GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Pulse) and what it computed, a model you choose writes the answer; threads are kept by the server
- [User guide](https://atlas.aziro.com/#docs/tour): what Atlas does, the dashboard, Code Map, search and Ask, impact and review, change lens, connected sources, Observe, skills and automations, one Atlas for a team — each page with screenshots and short clips recorded from a running Atlas
- [Benchmark & comparison](https://atlas.aziro.com/#benchmarks): interactive version of the published evidence
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/aziron-ai/atlas): releases (macOS, Linux, Windows), issues
- [GitHub Wiki](https://github.com/aziron-ai/atlas/wiki): mirror of the consumer product guide
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@aziron/atlas): `npm install -g @aziron/atlas`
- [GitHub Packages](https://github.com/aziron-ai/atlas/pkgs/npm/atlas): authenticated alternative `@aziron-ai/atlas`
